summary: Skeena Resources Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its Notice of Annual Meeting, Management Information Circular, and proxy materials for the June 22, 2026 annual general meeting. The circular covers routine proposals: receiving financial statements, setting board size at seven, electing directors, ratifying KPMG as auditor, and re-approving the rolling omnibus incentive plan. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private is disclosed. The filing is a standard proxy circular for an annual meeting and does not constitute a special situation.
